annotations.title: Deprivation, rural-urban class and nearest rail, bus and school

description:
What a neighbourhood is like on the official area measures: deprivation rank
    and decile, rural-urban class, output-area (OAC) class, and the nearest rail,
    bus and school distance. Use it for "what is the area like" questions about
    one postcode or one UPRN. Give `place` as {postcode} or {uprn}.

    England is ranked on the English index (rank of 33,755, decile 1 = most
    deprived). Wales is on its own Welsh index (rank of 1,917) and is NOT
    comparable with English ranks or deciles: never compare the two. Scotland,
    Northern Ireland, the Channel Islands and the Isle of Man are covered=false,
    which is not "no deprivation". Distances are straight-line metres and are held
    only for a UPRN that resolves to one land parcel; for a postcode, or a UPRN
    with no parcel, those fields are covered=false with the reason.

    It holds NO crime, school quality (Ofsted or results), demographics (age,
    income, ethnicity, tenure) or broadband data: say so rather than imply it.
    Do NOT use it to value, estimate or appraise anything. Postcode or uprn only:
    area and geometry places are refused, and free text is refused (call
    resolve_place first). Free.

    UK only. Exactly one record, no travel time. Free; covered=false or an upstream
    failure is not charged.

PlaceArg.description: Exactly one of uprn, postcode, area, geometry. Free text is refused: call resolve_place first.
